items.comments:
Joe and Anna are very friendly. They made us feel very well welcomed and comfortable. 
The house is gorgeous and spacious with newly upgraded decorations and furniture. Everything is prepared really well with thoughts. 
The location is awesome with very convenient access to downtown area with a lot of good restaurants, coffee shop and grocery stores.
Overall, it was an extraordinary experience and I highly recommend this house to everyone.
Listing was accurate, host even left neighborhood maps for reference.
Great house in a great neighborhood! Everything was as described and Joe and Anna had great communication. Will definitely stay here again!
Great house! Top notch location and appliances and overall decor and design. Great for kids esp backyard! Joe and Anna very helpful and accommodating to every need, even from afar. Highly recommended

Very clean and organized.  The hosts provided clear answers to a number of anticipated questions.  Fantastic location--across the street from recreation area and just a few blocks from shops/eats.  Would stay again.
